verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official local MCP server (Snyk Studio/MCP server running via the CLI) that lets coding agents connect and be prompted with natural language to scan for security issues, and a hands-on probe confirms the CLI actually responds to a JSON-RPC MCP handshake exposing tools/prompts/resources. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of MCP client interoperability across multiple agents, and clearer documentation on authentication requirements for the MCP server itself.
